content.short: thirdweb is the leading platform for web3 developers.
content.description: Founded by Furqan Rydhan and Steven Bartlett in 2021, thirdweb is a leading platform for web3 developers. It enables builders to create, manage, and analyze their web3 applications using a comprehensive set of services, including analytics platforms, authentication protocols, and decentralized storage options. To date, more than 55,000 developers have used its products, and the company has been valued at $160 million.
